hooks.command: bash -c 'errs=0; [ "${PYTHONUSERBASE:-}" = "$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310" ] || { echo "WARN: PYTHONUSERBASE not set to $HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310 (current: ${PYTHONUSERBASE:-unset})" >&2; errs=$((errs+1)); }; [ -d models ] || echo "WARN: models/ dir missing — run /download-ckpts" >&2; [ -d install/stcm ] || echo "INFO: install/stcm/ absent — run /build before launch" >&2; if [ -d install ] && [ stcm/setup.py -nt install ]; then echo "WARN: stcm/setup.py newer than install/ — install may be stale, consider /clean-build" >&2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); case "$cmd" in *"rm -rf /"*|*"rm -rf ~"*|*"rm -rf $HOME"*) echo "Blocked: destructive rm outside project scope" >&2; exit 2;; *"rm -rf models"*|*"rm -rf output"*|*"rm -rf stcm"*) echo "Blocked: cannot delete models/, output/, or stcm/ source" >&2; exit 2;; esac; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*|*"git push"*) if git diff --cached -U0 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^\+" | grep -Eiq "(api[_-]?key|secret|password|token|hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})"; then echo "BLOCK: staged diff looks like a secret. Inspect: git diff --cached" >&2; exit 2; fi; if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "^(models/|output/|build/|install/|log/|\.env)"; then echo "BLOCK: staged file under restricted path (models/output/build/install/log/.env). Unstage first." >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0'
bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.py) python3 -m py_compile "$f" 2>&1 | head -20 || echo "py_compile failed for $f" >&2;; esac; exit 0'

bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in stcm/nodes/*.py|stcm/stcm/nodes/*.py|stcm/image_listener.py|stcm/stcm/image_listener.py) if grep -nE "^[[:space:]]*print\(" "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -5 | grep -q .; then echo "NOTE: $f contains bare print() — prefer self.get_logger() in ROS nodes" >&2; fi;; esac; exit 0'
echo 'Verify: colcon build clean + ros2 launch dry-run before claiming done.' >&2
